columns.aum_usd: counted_assets in USD; blank when unpriced
columns.counted_assets: total_assets, or supply times the last accepted share price on guard days
columns.excluded_reason: set on every row of a vault left out of the aggregates (owner_funded:<link> by rule; self_dealing_loop or protocol_owned_liquidity by hand); see excluded_vaults.jsonl
columns.fill_days: days since the last vault event
columns.guard: share_price_jump when counted_assets is the book value
columns.held_by_vaults_usd: part of aum_usd held by other counted vaults that day (subtracted in the aggregates)
columns.price_rule: usd_peg, eth_ref, btc_ref, own, via_vault, unpriced; _carried when the last quote of up to 3 days earlier fills a DefiLlama gap
columns.source: accrue_interest (a vault event that day) or forward_fill
columns.total_assets: raw asset units at the end of the UTC day: the day's last AccrueInterest newTotalAssets plus later same-day deposits minus withdrawals; carried forward on days without a vault event
columns.total_supply: share supply replayed from flows and fee shares

what: Daily total assets and USD AUM per curated vault (Morpho V1 and V2, Moolah, Silo vaults, Euler Earn)
